text_block_list.text:
One day after the Nippon Derby.
To take a breather, I came to an amusement park with Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...!!
Trainer, which ride should we go on first!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Or should we get something in our stomachs first!?
I've had my eye on that bucket of popcorn
for a while now...!"

As I watched Special Week having fun
with a fond smile on my face—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhhhh!!
Spe-chan! Isn't that Spe-chan, yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah, El-chan?!
(El Condor Pasa—an Umamusume with a pro-wrestling spirit who aims to be the strongest in the world.)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, running into you even though
we're outside the academy is quite a surprise, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Spe-chan, don't tell me you're here to watch
the pro-wrestling event on the special stage too!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? N-No, I just came here
to catch a breather with my Trainer...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Excitement! Inspiration! Endless gratitude!
To think a fellow pro-wrestling fan was born right beside me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I didn't, okay?! I really didn't!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No need to be shy! Come, come, El will guide you
into a dazzling, soulful world, yes she will—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ailes~?
Now, now, you shouldn't trouble everyone~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haou?!

(Grass Wonder—a Yamato Nadeshiko Umamusume imbued with traditional grace,
harboring a fierce determination within.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Spe-chan...
And to you too, Spe-chan's Trainer.
I'll be sure to have a good talk with her later~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: G-Glaaaasss...! My tail... I thought my tail was gonna get ripped off...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's because you came on way too strong~. Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan...!
You came together with El-chan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I heard the haunted house here has a Japanese theme
and an exquisite atmosphere,
so I thought I'd take a peek while I was at it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-A haunted house...!?
Grass-chan, aren't you scared...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as long as you keep a calm heart,
there's nothing to be afraid of~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... Grass-chan really is
amazing after all...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, sorry for making a scene.
The event is starting soon, so I'll be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You two have fun at the amusement park, too~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: See ya, Grass-chaaan!!
choice_data_list: Spe's friends sure are lively, huh.
Spe's friends sure are lively, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Passionate El-chan with her love for pro wrestling,
and Grass-chan, always so gentle and smiling...
They're such lively, wonderfully fun friends."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, not just that—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They're both extremely strong.
When it comes to races, they're rivals I truly respect...!

"Indeed, Special Week gives the impression of being
constantly surrounded by numerous formidable rivals."
choice_data_list: I wonder if I'll get to race them someday too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's true.
Surely, someday...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Whoops, sorry about that!
We totally got carried away chatting.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: In any case, let's have lots of fun today!

And so, I fully enjoyed the amusement park
together with Special Week—
It happened on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... Well, well, if it isn't Spe-chan.
And her Trainer, too!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sei-chan!
Were you out and about too, Sei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, just a little bit of fishing~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, speaking of Spe-chan, she did amazing in the Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Which race are you aiming for next, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Next? Um...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Could it be~... that since you're aiming to be the best in Japan, you've got your eyes set on something like the Tenno Sho (Spring)?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring)...!!

Special Week's expression shifted.
...It was clear her heart was racing with excitement.

The Tenno Sho (Spring), the race boasting the longest distance among GⅠs.
She surely wants to add her name to the turf
where the finest Senior-class Umamusume gather.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right... Yeah.
I really want to participate...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then first up is the Kikuka Sho.
Two hill climbs and a grueling 3,000 meters...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If you're aiming for the Tenno Sho (Spring),
isn't this a race you ought to experience first?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right...! Um, Trainer,
first up is the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—I'm planning to run in both the Kikuka Sho and the Tenno Sho,
so see ya there~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eh, what!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei-chan is my... rival...!?
